projects.name: Distributed Honeypot & Threat Intel Collector | Docker, Python, Flask, Paramiko
projects.summary: Built a multi-container honeypot system (Docker Compose) with low-interaction SSH and HTTP traps capturing attacker credentials, exploit payloads, and session metadata in real time. Developed a central Flask telemetry API aggregating intrusion reports from distributed nodes into a unified SQLite threat intelligence database with an interactive CLI dashboard. Canary Token Generator & Breach Dashboard | Python, Flask, SQLite, Chart.js Created a canary token platform generating trackable HTTP links, MS Word pixel trackers, and decoy AWS Access Keys with a mock AWS STS endpoint returning realistic AccessDenied responses. Implemented GeoIP intruder fingerprinting and real-time webhook alerting to Slack, Discord, and Telegram on breach detection. SecurDNS Firewall Resolver | Python, dnslib, SQLite Engineered a custom DNS firewall intercepting phishing and malware domains via real-time blocklist matching, sinkholes to 0.0.0.0, with auto-syncing blocklist ingestion and an interactive management CLI. API Cartographer | JavaScript, Chrome DevTools API, SVG | Chrome Extension Developed a DevTools extension reverse-engineering backend API surfaces by intercepting fetch/XHR traffic and scanning scripts for undiscovered routes, with SVG network graphs and OpenAPI v3 export. FingerprintID | React, TypeScript, Web Crypto API | Live Demo Designed a browser fingerprinting analyzer generating unique SHA-256 device identifiers via canvas, WebGL GPU probing, AudioContext synthesis, and font enumeration with a privacy score dashboard. StegSafe | Cryptography, HTML5 Canvas, Flask | Live Demo Built a zero-knowledge steganography platform embedding encrypted messages in PNG images using browser-native AES-256-GCM, LSB pixel packing, and self-destructing burn-on-read links.
